title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: minor clear / major agreed; tip before GAR Cap. VII
pass_a_gloss: The minor is clear. How the major could be denied I do not see. We agree that through Adam hereditary corruption—which is truly sin—entered into all humans: that granted, why not take the Apostle's words of it? Tip before GAR Cap. VII § IX (actual by reatus).
pass_b_english: The Minor is clear. How the Major could be denied I do not see. For it is agreed and convenes between us that through Adam hereditary corruption which is truly sin entered into all humans: which being posited, what is there why we should not take the Apostle's words of it?
source_text: Minor est liquida. Maior quomodo negari possit non video. Constat enim & convenit inter nos per Adamum corruptionem haereditariam quae vere peccatum est in omnes homines ingressam esse: quo posito, quid est quamobrem de ea non accipiamus Apostoli verba?
